symptom: ako/mxcli#904: describe → exec of an AccessibilityHelper failed. Half 1 (describe emitted `content { }`, MDL-WIDGET26 "`content` is not a container of `accessibilityhelper` — it declares: attr, template") no longer reproduces on main — fixed by mendixlabs/mxcli#1400. Half 2 still did: an attributesList item `attr (attribute: 'aria-label', …)` made check --references, which exec runs first, report "widget '': Attribute 'aria-label' is bound but there is no enclosing data container providing entity context"
cause: walkWidgetsWithContext asked GetAttribute() of every AST node, including object-list ITEMS, whose properties are the item's own; AccessibilityHelper's item has a string property literally named `attribute` (the HTML attribute's name)
fix: skip the binding check on a child whose type is a container keyword of the enclosing widget's definition (unstoredContainerKinds, already used by the CE0495 rule for the same item-vs-widget question)
test: TestAccessibilityHelper_ItemAttributeIsNotABinding (+ RealUnboundAttributeStillReported control, SlotKeywordIsTemplate regression for half 1)
insight: **Reproduce each half of a multi-part report on main before fixing**: the headline error (MDL-WIDGET26) was already gone, and the half that remained is in a different layer — only check --references (project needed) refuses; plain check and exec --no-check both accept and round-trip it (mx 11.12.1: exec → describe → exec 'Unchanged page', mx check 0 errors). The item-vs-widget question had already been answered once in the same file for duplicate names; a second rule walking the same tree did not ask it. Housekeeping: knownUnsupportedContainers (ATTRIBUTE/ATTR/EVENT, #239) was stale since widgetTypeV3 gained `| keyword`; the test now asks the parser instead of keeping a list
